behaviours.expected_source: $s2 = 150 (300943 Effect[1] aura 163 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, EffectBasePoints 149, EffectMiscValue 127 all schools, MiscValueB 2). Tooltip: 'Increases your critical damage dealt by 150%'; the reference snapshots (coabuildhub spells_master_index) carry the same sentence 'by 150%' with no semantics, nothing found on whole-hit against bonus-only. The recorded choice (docs/coa/sun-cleric-completion.md:53) is 'native semantics for aura 163, no new total-critical-damage multiplier invented'. Native here is Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:10654-10663): crit_bonus = damage + damage/2 for a spell crit, AddPct(crit_bonus, 150) on that whole figure, then minus damage, so a crit hit of 1.5x becomes 3.75x and the ratio to the same crit without the aura is 2.5 (the Templar Chivalric 705272 reading). behaviours.quote: Your Glorious Execution now ignores $s1% of the target's armor while Vow of the Valkyr is active.
behaviours.expected_source: 704938 Vindicator: Effect[0] ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 12 on class mask word 2 bit 1048576 (Glorious Execution), BasePoints -11; the server rewrites it to SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT, BasePoints 9 (+1 = 10, $s1), mask (0, 4096, 4), kept at 0 unless Vow of the Valkyr 807749 is on the caster (AscensionSunClericRadiance.cpp:45-53, :81-88). Glorious Execution 803913 (maximum rank) is cast and its main-hand strike 800691 (Effect[0] of 803913 triggers it; the cast itself logs no damage, the first run counted 0 hits) is observed on the dummy in two arms, each hit non-critical. Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE, armor) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value), so the dummy's armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000) in both. Classic combat armor mitigation at caster level 60: damage kept = K / (armor + K), K = 85 x 60 + 400 = 5500 (Unit.cpp ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant, as the Witch Hunter Stake entry). Treatment arm: Vindicator learned and Vow of the Valkyr 807749 on the caster (a precondition fixture by harness set_aura, the condition of the clause, not its subject); control arm: Vow active, Vindicator not learned. Ignoring 10% of 5528 armor leaves 4975.2: the mean hit ratio is (5528 + 5500) / (4975.2 + 5500) = 1.0528 (+5.28%). The band is that of the stated 10% (G-19: the larger of 5% of it and 2 points, 8% to 12%), mapped through the same formula: 8% gives (5528 + 5500) / (5085.76 + 5500) = 1.0418 (+4.18%) and 12% gives (5528 + 5500) / (4864.64 + 5500) = 1.0640 (+6.40%), so the judged band is +-1.1 points on +5.28% (band_points 1.1, the smaller side), and a server ignoring 5% (+2.57%) or 15% (+8.13%) lies outside it. The 99% half-width at 498 trials per arm was 0.87 points (prove1, 3 parts of 166), so about 1930 trials per arm give the 0.44 the pilot sizes to: 12 parts of 166. Reference search 2026-11-20: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries the sentence ("ignores -10%", the sign an export artefact); coa-history spell 704938: 0 events in 186 logs, 803913 Glorious Execution 929 casts in 6 logs, no armor figure; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.observe_source: Gavel of Light 800611 hits the dummy and the server copies a share of its damage to the caster as 707522 (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:283-290): the share is the effect value of the passive 707521, BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($707521s1, 'heal yourself equal to $707521s1% of the damage dealt'). Solemn Priest 804269 Effect[1] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($s2) on the class mask of 707521 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2097152): 'an additional 50% of its damage dealt', so 100% of the damage with the passive against 50% without. Both phases cast one Gavel of Light at the dummy with the caster at 50% health and +20000 attack power (a harness fixture) so that the hit is the same to 0.4% from one cast to the next (the weapon roll of 17..29 is lost against about 3400 of attack power (20000 / 14 x 2.4)); the first run, as a hit_ratio of the heals, could not read a heal on the caster (a hit_ratio reads the heals on the target of the cast). spell_heal_total sums every matching heal event since the scenario started (the leech_ratio note), so the after reading carries the before heal: (H + 2H) / H = 3.0, tolerance 0.15 (the 5-point band on +100%). Both phases carry the class tuning aura 887015 (-20% healing done) alike. Control: the phase without the passive. Reference search 2026-11-20: bindmysoul has no Solemn Priest entry (advancement.tsv lists the name only); coa-history spell 804269: 0 events in 186 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Fixture 984954 ('Reg’s Test Aura') carries Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT, BasePoints 100 (+101% weapon crit), so every Gavel hit (800611, DmgClass 2, melee) is a critical strike in both phases; the heal is a share of the damage dealt, so the ratio of the two phases is unaffected.
